name: FugledeAudit.crt_bezout
statement:
theorem crt_bezout (q H : ℕ) (hcop : Nat.Coprime q H) :
    (H : ℤ) * Nat.gcdB q H + (q : ℤ) * Nat.gcdA q H = 1

name: FugledeAudit.cyclic_fourier_crt_pairing
statement:
theorem cyclic_fourier_crt_pairing (q H : ℕ) [NeZero q] [NeZero H]
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime q H) (a ξ : ZMod (q * H)) :
    cyclicFourierEntry a ξ =
      ZMod.stdAddChar ((physicalCRT q H a).1 * (dualCRT q H ξ).1) *
        ZMod.stdAddChar ((physicalCRT q H a).2 * (dualCRT q H ξ).2)

name: FugledeAudit.physical_crt_eq_chinese_remainder
statement:
theorem physical_crt_eq_chinese_remainder (q H : ℕ) (hcop : Nat.Coprime q H)

name: FugledeAudit.standard_character_crt
statement:
theorem standard_character_crt (q H : ℕ) [NeZero q] [NeZero H]
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime q H) (t : ℤ) :
    ZMod.stdAddChar (t : ZMod (q * H)) =
      ZMod.stdAddChar ((Nat.gcdB q H * t : ℤ) : ZMod q) *
        ZMod.stdAddChar ((Nat.gcdA q H * t : ℤ) : ZMod H)

name: FugledeAudit.standard_character_scaled

name: FugledeAudit.spectral_pair_weighted_fourier_zero

theorem spectral_pair_weighted_fourier_zero
    (q H : ℕ) [NeZero q] [NeZero H] (hq : q.Prime) (hcop : Nat.Coprime q H)

    (ξ μ : Λ) (r : ℕ)

    (spectralPrimeLevels q H Λ j).starProjection.toLinearMap *

      (spectralPrimeLevels q H Λ k).starProjection.toLinearMap = 0

    (T : ∀ j, localResidual U.toLinearMap (L j) ω q →ₗ[ℂ]

    (h₂ : ∀ j,

      (S j).comp (unitaryCompression U (localResidual U.toLinearMap (L (j + 1)) ω q)) = 0)
    (h₃ : ∀ j,

        (unitaryCompression U (localResidual U.toLinearMap (L j) ω q))).comp (S j) +
      ((unitaryCompression U (localResidual U.toLinearMap (L j) ω q)).comp (S j)).comp
        (unitaryCompression U (localResidual U.toLinearMap (L (j + 1)) ω q)) +
      (S j).comp ((unitaryCompression U (localResidual U.toLinearMap (L (j + 1)) ω q)).comp

    (henergy : ∀ j v, ‖v‖ ^ 2 =
